column1: # vault-audit plan rules. Copy to ~/.config/vault-org/rules.tsv (0600, not in the repo) and edit; every host and name below is
# invented. Format: kind<TAB>pattern<TAB>target-folder. First matching line wins; no match = keep the item where it is.
#   host    fnmatch on the item's URI hosts (lower case, no www., no port):  host  *.acme-corp.test  Work/Acme
#   name    fnmatch on the item name, case-insensitive
#   folder  fnmatch on the item's CURRENT folder name
#   type    login | note | card | identity | ssh
# Tool folders (Linux, MCP, Env/*) are never touched whatever the rules say.
